clues: This city sits in the heart of Iraq, just east of a large lake. In its part of the land, just one city, Baghdad, is larger.
Summers here are long, dry, and harsh with heat. Yet near all the year's rain falls from November to April, and no month is wet.
In the year 680, Husayn and most of his kin were slain here in a great fight. He was a grandson of the prophet Muhammad.
For one rite each year, up to forty million guests come here, most of them on foot. It is the largest crowd meet on Earth.
The shrines of Imam Husayn and Al-Abbas stand at the heart of this holy city. Their graves draw the great crowds here each year.
